title: EA-inequivalent vectorial bent functions with isomorphic translation designs
summary: Determine whether two EA-inequivalent vectorial bent functions can induce isomorphic translation designs.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether there exist an even integer $n\ge 8$, an integer $m$ with $2\le m\le n/2$, and vectorial bent functions $F,F':\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^m$ such that $F$ and $F'$ are not EA-equivalent but their translation designs are isomorphic: $\operatorname{dev}(G_F)\cong\operatorname{dev}(G_{F'})$. A positive answer requires one verified pair; a negative answer must prove nonexistence throughout the stated parameter range.

scope.domain: Translation designs of vectorial bent functions
assumptions: $2\le m\le n/2$, excluding the Boolean case $m=1$
EA-equivalence and translation-design isomorphism use the source definitions
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source rules out the relevant collision in four and six variables. Find one pair for some even n >= 8 and 2 <= m <= n/2, or prove that no such pair exists for every admissible n and m.

progress.summary: After excluding dimensions four and six, the source asks whether the Boolean translation-design collision phenomenon can occur for vectorial bent functions.
